verdict.rationale: Runloop Devboxes explicitly support long-running persistence via snapshots (save/restore disk state), suspend/resume to pause and continue exactly where left off, and Axons providing a persistent event stream that lets agents suspend when idle and wake on demand/recover state — directly addressing multi-hour/multi-day agent sessions without losing progress. Combined with SSH/tunnel access and mounts/secrets for long tasks, this covers the core story well. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence (e.g., a third-party report) confirming multi-day session stability at scale, and explicit documented max session duration/limits.
